(Currently Amended) A method for selecting a server computer for sending data to a client computer, the method comprising the steps of: accessing a server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers; adding information indicative of at least one server computer of the first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on a second server computer, the resource having a unique signature as part of its identifier; __wherein the information is added to the locator prior to transmission to the client computer__; and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.
